title: DeepRescore2 improves phosphopeptide identification and finds EGFR hyperactivation
summary: DeepRescore2 rescores phosphoproteomics identifications with deep-learning retention-time and fragment-ion intensity predictions. It increased correct peptide-spectrum matches by 17% in a synthetic dataset and found 19% to 46% more phosphopeptides in biological datasets. In a liver cancer dataset it uniquely identified EGFR hyperactivation in poor-prognosis tumors, which was validated experimentally.
ai_technology: Deep-learning retention-time and fragment-ion intensity prediction used to rescore peptide identifications

evidence.tested: EGFR hyperactivation was validated experimentally; the workflow was benchmarked against a state-of-the-art pipeline.
evidence.unknown: Details of the EGFR experiment are not in the abstract. Abstract-based; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Deep-learning predictions rescored spectra to recover phosphopeptides missed by the benchmark workflow.
